'''2007 Worlds Team Team Awesome DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Team Awesome]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Player name blacked out; Team Awesome. Omni Box struck kept; All Too Easy fills OCR gap line 38.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Team Awesome]]

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
